text_block_list.text:
Th-the spring Tenno Sho... There's no
way I'm
winning...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
But I want everyone to know I'm capable
of
running long distances too! I'll g-give
it a go!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Why if it isn't you, Doto! To think our
paths would
cross before the Takarazuka
Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
O-Opera O. Please, go easy on me
today.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Of course. Today is not a time for
sparring. This is
a parade, an
extravaganza!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: No, no, no... Parade! Where's your pomp, my friend?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
They're a common staple at theme
parks, are they
not? Princes, princesses,
and mascots shown off in
a wonderful
procession.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Think of today's event as the same—a
parade to
introduce us to the fans who
shall watch our
coming races!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
How about it, Doto? Can I trust you, as
a member
of the main cast, to properly
guide me, the
Overlord, down this road?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Guide you? ...I, I'll do it! 3,200 meters is
a little
daunting though...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I won't flub this up. I won't give in... I'll
see this
through!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
As our prelude to the Takarazuka Kinen,
we'll
start by overcoming the Yodo
slope.
